01 / Closure against the original audit

Every finding has a remedy and proof.

The original audit is preserved. These are implemented changes, with domain checks and rendered interaction evidence behind each closure.

01✓ REMEDIED

Yen have a visible purpose.

Original finding The ¥48,000 catalog was overwhelmed by passive income.

Four optional, one-time room projects provide ¥2.4m of savings goals. A bookshelf, lantern strand, garden and hanami setting appear permanently when purchased. The core restaurant has an explicit finish after its 21 rewards.

What proves it ↗

Actual service simulations show daily visitors still saving for the final project on day 42; weekly visitors afford all core rewards and two projects. Browser purchase → room change → reload passes. Authenticated backend checks prove server pricing, authorization and exactly-once debit.

projects.ts · domain-service.ts · restaurant-scene.ts · companion-view.ts
02✓ REMEDIED

The two empty income steps now pay off.

Original finding The knife spent ¥2,400 for 20 → 20; the counter spent ¥5,400 for 40 → 40.

Knife adds +1 ¥/order; the counter adds +1 ¥/order. The license adds +3, keeping the final rate at 90. Fresh chapter-order income is 20 → 20 → 22 → 44 → 48 → 72 → 90. The storage upgrade improves storage rather than minute income.

What proves it ↗

Domain and browser checks compare preview, actual purchased state and announcement. Generic equal-capacity explanations name the future bottleneck. Legacy license owners retain their purchased benefit; previews explain bonuses already received.

catalog.ts · domain-service.ts · sushi-view.ts
03✓ REMEDIED

The first renovation fits a short visit.

Original finding A bronze-qualified newcomer needed 30 productive minutes to buy the first upgrade.

The prep counter costs ¥50 at the unchanged base rate of 10 ¥/min. The first cash target takes five minutes. Bronze eligibility remains required, and the menu explains when restaurant income starts.

What proves it ↗

A zero-yen, bronze-qualified browser fixture advances exactly five minutes, collects ¥50, buys the prep counter, and ends at ¥0 with 20 ¥/min. The same boundary is tested through the real domain service.

catalog.ts · sushi-view.ts · tests/e2e/sushi-balance-remedies.spec.ts
04✓ REMEDIED

The register respects daily study rhythms.

Original finding An 8h/12h cap rewarded several checks per day and stopped overnight.

New restaurants store 24h; the chapter-7 purchase stores 48h. Full-register copy says saved income remains safe and invites collection when convenient. Existing saves settle old earnings before adopting the new future rules.

What proves it ↗

Fixed-rate daily and twice-daily collection earn the same total. The modeled route differs by just ¥7,200 because an earlier visit buys the first upgrade earlier. Migration tests verify old capped earnings, discarded stopped time and idempotent future-only changes.

types.ts · domain-service.ts · sushi-view.ts
05✓ REMEDIED

Every gold achievement has a permanent home.

Original finding Seven gold decorations competed for one wall slot and one floor slot.

All seven chapter honors appear in their own display as soon as permanent gold grants are earned. They require neither a purchase nor an equipped decoration and survive later practice-score changes. Wall/floor customization remains separate.

What proves it ↗

Domain tests check permanent grants independently of current progress. Browser fixtures show all seven honors with an empty wallet, no inventory and both decor slots empty; they persist after reload.

study-companion.ts · companion-view.ts
06✓ REMEDIED

Goals explain their value; guests teach the course.

Original finding A catalog-order checklist mixed cosmetic and production goals. Guests repeated three fixed phrases.

Separate “Bygg vidare” and “Inred” suggestions consider useful effects, affordability and actual study gates. Guests offer seven chapter-specific recall decks with Japanese, readings, Swedish meaning and the course source. Reveal and next support optional practice.

What proves it ↗

A service-limited restaurant recommends the conveyor ahead of cosmetics; switching goal type changes the suggestion. Browser checks verify selected chapter, source, reveal and next, while course records, grants, inventory and yen remain unchanged.

study-companion.ts · companion-view.ts · sushi-view.ts
02 / Re-run the same scenarios

Useful savings, a reachable core.

Start at zero. A chapter’s three grants become eligible every seven days, through day 42. Each visit collects, buys core rewards, then considers optional projects in order.

The remaining money is a budget toward the next visible project. The goal is a finite, generous game with meaningful optional choices, rather than an endlessly empty wallet.

Expected chapter order

The income curve has useful steps.

20→20→22→44→48→72→90

Chapters 6 → 12. The knife and counter now improve income immediately on the expected route. Chapter 7 improves storage time. The final maximum stays at 90 ¥/min.

Legacy license benefits are preserved through a revenue floor. A previously bought +5 license can absorb the new +1 bonuses; its preview explains why those points have already been received.

At a fixed rate, daily and twice-daily collections now earn the same total. The modeled ¥7,200 difference comes from buying the first upgrade earlier, rather than an overnight cap penalty.

These scenarios establish the new pacing mechanics. Student satisfaction and long-term learning effects still require student playtesting.

The 21 course rewards remain the finish line.

Every modeled cadence completes the core restaurant by day 42. Weekly visitors also build two optional projects; daily visitors build three and still have a real savings target. Projects never block honors, guest practice, or the completion celebration.
